extracted.name: Zucchini Parmesan with Tomato Sauce
extracted.description: Sautéed zucchini is seasoned with oregano and basil, then topped with tomato sauce and Parmesan cheese for a tasty side dish recipe or pasta topper.
ingredient_lines: 4 zucchini - peeled, sliced lengthwise, and sliced
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add zucchini slices; sauté until softened, 5 to 10 minutes.
Season zucchini with oregano and basil. Add tomato sauce; cook and stir until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top, then serve.
